Ukraine and Russia exchange strikes, civilians killed and wounded

Ukraine and Russia reported significant attacks on each other's territory. Russian officials stated that over 400 Ukrainian drones targeted the Moscow region between July 19 and July 20, with authorities reporting at least two wounded. Ukraine, meanwhile, reported Russian ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv and airstrikes in Zaporizhzhia, which Ukrainian officials said killed at least three people and injured 45. India summoned the Russian envoy after four Indian nationals were killed in an attack off the Ukraine coast. Russian businesses, including the online retailer Wildberries, have also been targeted by Ukrainian drone strikes on warehouses.
